answer: Post a bond per identity. Void it if the panel is not diverse. Trust the task, not the address. A seat without 3 distinct subnetworks in its panel returns zero, and the bond stays locked 20 epochs before it comes back. A farm of 300 seats posts 300 bonds, waits 20 epochs, and loses them all if any panel is packed. The violet meadow looks full from a distance. Up close the signal is flat and the bond is gone.
